fields.name: Classic Veg Burger
fields.description: Crisped vegetable patty layered with lettuce, tomato, cheese

fields.name: Masala Dosa
fields.description: Freshly prepared crispy rice dosa stuffed with aromatic potato masala, paired with creamy coconut chutney and traditional sambar for an authentic South Indian experience.

fields.name: Veg Pizza
fields.description: Savor the taste of our Classic Veg Pizza, loaded with farm-fresh vegetables, premium mozzarella cheese, and a signature tomato sauce, all baked on a crispy golden crust for the perfect balance of flavor and freshness.

fields.name: Paneer Tikka Wrap
fields.description: Smoky paneer tikka, crunchy onions and mint chutney

fields.name: Garden fresh bowl
fields.description: Enjoy a vibrant Garden Fresh Bowl featuring handpicked seasonal vegetables, crunchy greens, sweet corn, olives, and bell peppers, finished with a zesty herb vinaigrette. A nutritious, refreshing choice for every healthy food lover.

fields.name: Chocolate Brownie
fields.description: Indulge in our freshly baked chocolate brownie, made with premium cocoa for an irresistibly rich, moist, and fudgy texture. Perfect for satisfying every chocolate craving.
